request.user:
Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

A wooden cube just floats inside water when a 800 g mass is placed on it. When the mass is removed, the cube is 2 cm above the water level. What is the size of the side of the cube (in cm) ?

result.working:
With the 800 g mass on top, the cube is just fully submerged. When the mass is removed, a 2 cm layer of the cube rises above the water.
The buoyant force lost equals the weight of the removed mass: a² × 2 cm × ρ_w × g = 0.8 kg × g.
Taking ρ_w = 1 g/cm³ gives a² × 2 × 1 = 800, so a² = 400.
Therefore a = 20 cm.
